verdict.rationale: CMS IndusLaw is a full-service law firm offering legal advisory services, not a software product where users store data and get in-product AI-generated insights, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm ships any client-facing software or AI insight tool that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
